name: Pizza Restaurant Manager
summary:
Welcome to Pizza Restaurant Manager, the ultimate arcade idle game where you take control of a growing pizzeria! Start with a small pizza shop, craft delicious recipes, and satisfy hungry customers. Manage ingredients, hire staff, and upgrade equipment to boost efficiency. Experiment with new toppings, handle customer demands, and expand your business into a pizza empire.

With engaging idle mechanics, your pizzeria keeps running even when you're offline, ensuring steady growth. Strategically invest in auto
